Neither supplies a sufficiently parallel structure or concrete language for the child's brief commendatory message.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am delighted to join with the Reserve Officers Association and patriotic Americans everywhere in the observance of National Defense Week.","parent_excerpt":"I am happy to join with you in the recognition of the 70th Anniversary of the establishment of the Federal Civil Service merit system.","explanation":"C06 has the strongest verbal parallel, but the formula of joining an organization in recognizing an observance is conventional ceremonial correspondence."},{"child_excerpt":"A more fitting period for such purpose could hardly be chosen","parent_excerpt":"The importance of aviation to our nation and to the world makes it particularly fitting that the fiftieth Anniversary of this epochal event be observed in an appropriate manner.","explanation":"C22 shares the language of an observance being particularly fitting, but the remainder is an administrative direction to plan an anniversary rather than a parallel commendatory message."},{"child_excerpt":"National security is everybody's job today","parent_excerpt":"Every citizen is urged to do his utmost in aiding the development of effective reserve components of our armed forces","explanation":"C13 expresses the same citizen-reserve-defense concept, but does so through an executive order with materially different language and machinery."}]}
